skill.name: writing-assistant
skill.description: Guides Chinese self-media writers from topic selection to publish-ready article structure, titles, and formatting.
skill.summary: A Chinese writing workflow for planning, drafting, checking, and improving self-media articles.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: All static findings were reviewed against the Markdown source. The command-execution, hidden-file, and entropy alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, a normal README install path, and Chinese UTF-8 text. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or hidden executable behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Static scanners may flag Markdown backticks as command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use clearer prose around filenames and formatting examples when possible, and keep executable commands only in fenced install sections.

remediation.issue: The README references a hidden Claude skills directory.
remediation.suggestion: Label the command as a manual installation step so reviewers know the skill does not access that path at runtime.

content.value_statement: Self-media writers need a repeatable way to move from idea to publishable draft. This skill guides topic choice, outline, body copy, titles, and formatting with checklists.
actual_capabilities: Routes writing requests to topic, outline, draft, title, formatting, or diagnosis workflows.
Guides topic selection with audience, context, information value, and prior research checks.
Builds article outlines using awareness, interest, decision, and action stages.
Reviews body copy for visual support, paragraph length, jargon, and opening clarity.
Improves titles with numeric contrast, dramatic wording, and lower reading barriers.
Checks publishing format with heading, list, spacing, and ASCII flow rules.
limitations: The skill is written for Chinese self-media writing workflows.
Users must customize audience, positioning, forbidden topics, and terminology files.
It does not publish content or connect to social platforms.
It provides writing structure and checks, not factual research verification.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Article
use_cases.description: Turn a rough topic into a scoped article plan with audience, context, value, and structure checks.

use_cases.title: Review a Draft Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Score a draft against topic, outline, body, title, and formatting rules before release.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Weak Article Performance
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to identify weak audience fit, missing reasoning, poor title design, or formatting gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Start a New Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me plan a Chinese self-media article about [topic]. Ask for my audience and goal first.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for [topic] using the awareness, interest, decision, and action stages. Include at least three audience groups.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft with the skill checklist. Score each stage, identify failed checks, and suggest focused edits.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Low Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: This article performed poorly. Diagnose likely causes using topic fit, promise strength, opening clarity, title design, and formatting.

output_examples.input: I want to write about AI note taking for beginners.
output_examples.output: The skill would define beginner audiences, test market demand, estimate information value, and propose a staged outline before drafting.

output_examples.input: Here is my draft. Please check if it is ready to publish.
output_examples.output: The skill would return a checklist score, failed items, priority fixes, and a publish, optimize, or rewrite recommendation.

output_examples.input: My article title is too plain.
output_examples.output: The skill would generate title options using numeric contrast, lower reading barriers, and clearer reader outcomes.

best_practices: Customize the audience and positioning files before using the workflow.
Run the checklist after each major stage instead of only at the end.
Pair title suggestions with honest claims that the article can support.
anti_patterns: Do not skip audience definition and write for only one reader type.
Do not use strong titles that promise more than the article delivers.
Do not treat the checklist as factual verification for claims or data.

faq.question: What language is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for Chinese self-media writing and Chinese platform formatting habits.

faq.question: Can it write a complete article?
faq.answer: It can guide planning, drafting, and revision, but users should provide topic knowledge and facts.

faq.question: Does it publish content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It only provides writing guidance, checklists, and suggested revisions.

faq.question: What should I customize first?
faq.answer: Customize your positioning, forbidden topics, audience personas, and terminology explanations.

faq.question: Can it help with poor article metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can diagnose likely issues in topic selection, outline, title, opening, and formatting.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
